card.name: Words just before a noun completes
card.fires_on: Modifier or first-part words that expect a following noun, such as 'medium' before 'heat', 'loading' before 'dose', the '0' in '300 mg', and 'tank lights'. Appears in recipes, dosing text and general web prose.

modes.label: Cooking and canning steps
modes.description: A modifier in a recipe or food-prep step that is followed by a noun like heat or jars.
modes.example: cook chicken in oil over<< medium>> heat for five to six minutes on each

modes.label: Dose wording
modes.description: Part of a dose phrase, such as the digit in 300 or 'loading' before 'dose'.
modes.example: the<< loading>> dose of prasugrel tablets was

modes.label: Other half-finished phrases
modes.description: General web phrases where the marked word leads into a noun or verb partner.
modes.example: Decision<< making>> is an integral part of our life.
